title: Expose authenticated owner creation of planned visits
requirements: Add an explicitly injected AdminCommandRuntime containing only an Engine, a non-empty HMAC secret and a positive digest-key version. It adapts the existing OwnerCommandService; production composition, defaults and secrets remain absent.

Expose POST /api/v1/admin/visits for the already accepted create_planned_visit payload {service_id, start_at, duration_minutes}. It requires an existing valid owner session, exact trusted Origin, application/json content type, X-CSRF-Token matching that session and Idempotency-Key. Missing or invalid session returns 401 AUTH_REQUIRED without command execution; invalid origin returns 403 FORBIDDEN; bad/missing CSRF returns 403 CSRF_FAILED; non-JSON returns 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.

Require a strict JSON object with no transport fields and delegate only the three accepted semantic fields to OwnerCommandService. On first success return 201 with {data:{command_id,visit:{id,version,status}}}; an identical accepted retry returns 200 with the same data and Idempotent-Replay: true. Do not create another visit, receipt or audit event on replay.

Map the existing safe command outcomes without exposing diagnostics: IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH to 409, RESULT_EXPIRED to 410, VALIDATION_ERROR or OPTION_UNAVAILABLE to 422, and other unsupported command input to 422 VALIDATION_ERROR. All responses use the existing no-store envelope. Rejections before acceptance do not consume the idempotency key.

Add focused route-contract tests plus isolated synthetic PostgreSQL integration coverage for authentication, trusted origin, CSRF, content type, strict body shape, first creation, replay, idempotency mismatch, inactive/unknown service and persistence/audit boundaries. Tests create random disposable databases and never read a local .env or use a configured source database.
Do not expose inquiry commands, manual inquiry entry, payment commands, catalog changes, a production runtime, frontend assets, bot adapters, migrations, external calls or secrets.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can create an empty planned visit through HTTP and immediately see it in the authenticated calendar read model.
CSRF, origin, session, idempotency and domain validation remain enforced before any visit is persisted.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted first owner write endpoint, strictly adapting the reviewed transactional visit-creation core behind the established session and CSRF boundary.
